chart.programText:
A = data('controller_runtime_active_workers', filter=filter('controller', 'seldon-controller-manager'), rollup='latest').sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('controller_runtime_max_concurrent_reconciles', filter=filter('controller', 'seldon-controller-manager'), rollup='latest').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/B).scale(100).publish(label='C')

chart.programText:
A = histogram('seldon_api_executor_server_requests_seconds', filter=filter('code', '2*', '3*')).count(by=['seldon-app']).rate(by=['seldon-app']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
